name: Chewy Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Cookie Bars

instructions.primary_message: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 175°C (350°F). Lightly grease an 8- by 20-cm metal baking pan with cooking spray, then line with parchment paper, leaving a 2.5-cm overhang on two opposite sides. Set aside.

In a small saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Cook, stirring frequently, until the milk solids are amber-colored and butter smells nutty, about 7 minutes. Immediately transfer browned butter to a large heatproof bowl and whisk in cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and allspice. (You do not need to wipe out the pan.)

Add pumpkin purée to now-empty saucepan and stir to incorporate any browned bits. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until pumpkin begins to sizzle and large bubbles form beneath the surface, 2 to 3 minutes. Continue cooking, stirring frequently, until pumpkin is slightly darker, visibly drier, and reduced to about 6 1/2 tablespoons, 5 to 6 minutes longer. Whisk reduced pumpkin into browned butter mixture. Refrigerate, uncovered, until cooled to room temperature (about 20 minutes).
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, salt, and baking soda.

Into the cooled pumpkin mixture, whisk brown sugar, granulated sugar, and vanilla until well combined. Using a flexible spatula, fold in flour mixture until only a few dry streaks remain. Add 1 cup chocolate chips and continue folding until evenly incorporated and no dry flour remains.
Scrape dough into prepared pan and spread into an even layer. Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup chocolate chips evenly over top, pressing them gently into dough.
Bake until top appears dry, center is just set but still soft, and a wooden skewer or toothpick inserted into center comes out clean or streaked only with melted chocolate, 25 to 30 minutes.
Transfer pan to a wire rack and let bars cool completely in pan, 1 to 2 hours. Using parchment overhang, lift bars out of pan. Cut into 12 portions and serve.

description: These chewy pumpkin chocolate chip cookie bars combine browned butter, warm spices, and bittersweet chocolate in an easy, no-scoop fall dessert.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 2 hr 15 min.

Notes: Use plain canned pumpkin purée, not pumpkin pie filling, which contains added sugar and spices.

Make-ahead and storage: The cooled bars can be stored in a tightly sealed zip-top bag or airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days.
To freeze, wrap individual bars tightly in plastic wrap, transfer to a freezer-safe zip-top bag, and freeze for up to 1 month. Thaw at room temperature before serving.
author: Leah Colins
